query:
-- HE Néroli - Oranger amer
UPDATE raw_materials rm
SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Citrus aurantium%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-001' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Petit-grain Bigarade - Oranger amer
UPDATE raw_materials rm
SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Citrus aurantium%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-002' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Jasmin - Jasmin
UPDATE raw_materials rm
SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Jasminum%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-003' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Tubéreuse - Tubéreuse
UPDATE raw_materials rm
SET plant_id = (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE latin_name LIKE '%Polianthes%' OR name LIKE '%Tubéreuse%' LIMIT 1)
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-004' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;

-- HE Géranium Bourbon - Géranium

-- HE Palmarosa - Palmarosa

-- HE Cyprès - Cyprès

-- HE Genévrier - Genévrier

WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-HE-008' AND rm.plant_id IS NULL;
